top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Chequamegon MTB's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
Chequamegon MTB's American Birkebeiner Ski Trail, Forest roads forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 41 miles.
When someone attacks on chequamegon National Forest—MTB singletrack +, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Chequamegon MTB, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
2-minute all-out efforts on chequamegon National Forest—MTB singletrack +. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
41 miles on chequamegon National Forest—MTB singletrack + burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
61ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Chequamegon MTB, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Varied gradients on chequamegon National Forest—MTB singletrack + demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Smooth pedaling at 41 miles saves muscle. Bad technique at mile 10 is invisible. At mile 80 it's a cramp.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Chequamegon MTB's chequamegon National Forest—MTB singletrack + actually does to you.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Chequamegon MTB. Train it until it feels boring.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Chequamegon MTB’s 40 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Chequamegon MTB requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on chequamegon national forest—mtb singletrack + forest roads to build confidence. Expect: american birkebeiner ski trail, forest roads, snowmobile routes.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Gravel Specific, and VO2max to prepare you for 41 miles of chequamegon national forest—mtb singletrack + forest roads in Cable, Wisconsin (Chequamegon National Forest).
